Alex: Day 1 quick question — trying to map ownership: who is the service steward for billing-service? Also who should I CC for infra/config changes and who to page if ingestion breaks? I need DB creds + kafka topic access. :wave:
Maria G.: @Ben owns billing-service app-level stuff. For infra/config tickets cc infra-eng and add the service tag. DB creds come from infra-access; open a request and link to the repo/PR. Oncall for ingestion is currently the ingest-sre rotation (pager goes to #eng-oncall then to the rotation).
Ben: yep that's me — billing-service steward. For onboarding: 1) create an infra-access ticket (https://go/redwood/infra-access) 2) paste the service repo and deployment env (staging/dev/prod) 3) include your manager approval in the ticket.
Ben: For kafka topics we add you to the dev-consuming group first. For prod topics we require a short runbook + approval from the data-platform team.
Alex: thanks — what exact string should I put in the ticket for the service repo? repo name or path?
Ben: repo name is fine, e.g., redwood/billing-service. Add the exact topic names you need (billing.events, billing.invoices). If you need write perms explain the use-case.
Priya: Also for any schema/migration work — ping me. We require migration verification in the sandbox and a canary plan. Quick checklist: run migrations against sandbox, run integration tests, add the migration to the rollout policy in the repo, then request approval from the schema-owners.
Priya: Example command we use for the sandbox: ``psql sandbox-db -f migrations/2026_add_billing_table.sql`` then run `./scripts/integration_tests.sh`. Keep changes small and reversible.
Sanjay: Oncall escalation: pager -> #eng-oncall -> if the rotation doesn't ack in 5 minutes, escalate to oncall-manager@redwood (alias). For Sev1: follow the incident playbook in /docs/incidents and escalate to paging manager after 15 minutes. If you suspect data loss, page immediately.
InfraBot: Access request created: IR-12345 by Alex (status: pending).
Alex: Awesome — putting together the ticket now. Do I need to be added to any Slack channels or groups for faster coordination?
Maria G.: Add yourself to #billing, #data-platform, and #infra-requests. Also join the infra-sso group (infra-sso@redwood) for automated group-based grants — mention your manager for the auto-approve flow.
Ben: If you want, I can do a 15min pairing session later today to walk through the repo and deployment flow.
Alex: Would love that, thank you! :slightly_smiling_face:
Maria G.: Welcome aboard, Alex! Ping us for anything else. :tada:
